plain_italian_summary: Gli agenti confermano che il modello margini e' utile ma non autorizza il live commerciale. Action Pack 25 e' il prodotto piu' sano, Score Pack 1k e' vicino al target, mentre Target Discovery e Deep Analysis richiedono revisione prezzo/costo prima di venderli davvero.

agent_votes.position: Do not enable live payments. Require measured cost per valid output before any paid sale.

product_notes.target_discovery_pack_250: margin too low at planning assumptions; review price or reduce data/agent cost
product_notes.score_pack_1k: near target; acceptable for further controlled modeling
product_notes.deep_analysis_pack_100: margin too low; needs cost reduction or higher price
product_notes.action_pack_25: best candidate if Deep Analysis gate remains mandatory

agent_votes.position: Keep product gates strict: Action Pack only after valid Deep Analysis, Deep Analysis only after score/confidence rules.

product_notes.target_discovery_pack_250: must return exact output contract or no-go coverage decision
product_notes.score_pack_1k: must keep idempotency and duplicate protection
product_notes.action_pack_25: must keep CRM-ready payload and audit event

agent_votes.position: Lead with Score Pack plus Action Pack path. Do not push Target Discovery as first paid product until margin improves.

product_notes.target_discovery_pack_250: use as high-value add-on or raise price
product_notes.deep_analysis_pack_100: sell only after strong score, not as generic report

agent_votes.position: No live sale until terms, privacy, data processing and no-guarantee language are approved.

product_notes.score_pack_1k: must state decision-support, not guaranteed revenue
product_notes.action_pack_25: must avoid automatic outreach without approval

agent_votes.position: Next step should revise price/cost assumptions while keeping all commercial gates blocked.

required_before_live: Deep Analysis gate must be enforced
cost per valid action pack must stay below 1.80 EUR
CRM payload and audit event must remain machine-readable
cost per valid score must stay below 0.033 EUR
score must include decision, confidence and reason codes
cost per valid report must stay below 1.06 EUR or price must increase
evidence and risk fields must be consistent
total cost must stay below 65 EUR or price must increase
valid target output rate must stay above 85%
no-go coverage decision must be accepted as valid deliverable
no contact harvesting or outreach claim

portfolio_decision.recommended_pre_live_positioning: Score Pack 1k as scalable entry, Action Pack 25 as premium gated output, Deep Analysis and Target Discovery under price/cost review.

recommended_next_action.name: price_revision_and_live_candidate_pack
recommended_next_action.plain_italian: Preparare una revisione del listino pre-live: mantenere Action Pack e Score Pack come candidati principali, ricalcolare Target Discovery e Deep Analysis, e definire cosa dovrebbe cambiare prima della vendita reale.
